finding_to_source_to_proof.finding: Mutable or reordered bundle bytes could differ between parent validation and worker loading.
finding_to_source_to_proof.resolution: Open the bundle directory once, seal the manifest first, derive payload order from that frozen manifest, and seal payloads through the same directory descriptor.
finding_to_source_to_proof.proof: AneBindingHardeningReview clean verdict on 7dd259d1; static source review of the manifest-first snapshot path.

finding_to_source_to_proof.finding: Parent file descriptors could collide with fixed child descriptor destinations during posix_spawn actions.
finding_to_source_to_proof.resolution: Compute a source floor above every fixed child target and duplicate all sources above it before adding any child dup2 action.
finding_to_source_to_proof.proof: Scoped doctest exercises a real fork/dup2 A/B/C payload handoff; included in the 8/8, 244/244 passing run.

finding_to_source_to_proof.finding: The public startup budget could expire during setup and still spawn a hardware-initializing worker.
finding_to_source_to_proof.resolution: Carry one checked absolute deadline from API entry and check it immediately before posix_spawn, destroying spawn actions before the named error.
finding_to_source_to_proof.proof: AneLifecycleHardeningReview clean verdict on exact 7dd259d1; runtime.cpp compiled with -Wall -Wextra -Werror.

finding_to_source_to_proof.finding: Oversized, malformed, or unreadable quarantine state could be deleted while acquisition unwound, allowing the next attempt.
finding_to_source_to_proof.resolution: Arm preservation before state open/read and clear it only after successful validation and marker write.
finding_to_source_to_proof.proof: Scoped doctest asserts the 129-byte marker remains after the first error and the second acquire fails identically. Independent reviewer repro reported state_exists=1 and the same invalid-state error on retry.

finding_to_source_to_proof.finding: Concurrent execute, shutdown, and accessor calls could race shared staging, serial, socket, and usability state.
finding_to_source_to_proof.resolution: Serialize complete transactions with a timed mutex against the caller's absolute deadline and synchronize accessors.
finding_to_source_to_proof.proof: Both lifecycle and binding reviewers reported the combined mechanism clean on exact 7dd259d1.

finding_to_source_to_proof.finding: A worker could send or execute after its absolute deadline, and a later-program failure could be misclassified as pre-execution after an earlier submission.
finding_to_source_to_proof.resolution: Check immediately before every send and ane_exec, and track whether any program in the command was submitted before selecting the reply class.
finding_to_source_to_proof.proof: Worker submission-boundary named-error test is included in the passing scoped doctest; both reviewers reported the full classification path clean.

finding_to_source_to_proof.finding: Independent runtimes and uncertain workers could overlap device ownership or lose eventual waitpid ownership.
finding_to_source_to_proof.resolution: Hold and validate a host lock in parent and child, persist boot-scoped quarantine after uncertainty, and adopt every live uncertain child into the process-lifetime reaper.
finding_to_source_to_proof.proof: Scoped ownership tests cover same-process and forked-process exclusion, same-boot refusal, changed-boot release, and corrupt-state retry refusal; both reviewers reported the lifecycle mechanism clean.

finding_to_source_to_proof.finding: Multi-channel C-plane addressing could overlap plane padding and prior fixtures could conceal invalid allocation geometry.
finding_to_source_to_proof.resolution: Use the checked plane-stride formula with a valid 0x4000-byte allocation fixture and exact physical offsets.
finding_to_source_to_proof.proof: Exact packing and unpacking assertions are included in the passing scoped doctest; binding review reported the fixture clean.

finding_to_source_to_proof.finding: An installed worker could be found correctly but fail before main because it had no runtime search path for the sibling libmlx.so.
finding_to_source_to_proof.resolution: Install the worker with the existing mlx-omarchy-info `$ORIGIN/../lib` RUNPATH pattern.
finding_to_source_to_proof.proof: The preserved 3172 run fails at dynamic loading in jwm1-3172-installed-startup-failure.log:27; the exact 9ea wheel records RUNPATH and both real workers execute and release in jwm1-9ea7501f-acceptance.log:132-180.

finding_to_source_to_proof.finding: In a static libmlx build, dladdr on the runtime anchor resolves the consumer executable, never the TARGET_FILE:mlx archive, so worker selection cannot establish a loaded-library installation prefix.
finding_to_source_to_proof.resolution: Reject private ANE runtime configuration unless BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON. Preserve static Omarchy GPU and host bundle builds when the private runtime is disabled.
finding_to_source_to_proof.proof: Actual static+ANE CMake configure exits 1 with the named requirement; actual static libmlx.a bundle consumer has no dynamic libmlx dependency and passes 20/20 cases and 1802/1802 assertions.

finding_to_source_to_proof.finding: Shell probe output could fail before filling an array, after which an unbound subscript hid the real metadata error.
finding_to_source_to_proof.resolution: Use importlib.metadata.version("mlx-omarchy") and atomic, exact-cardinality files before any shell field extraction; validate mapped core/libmlx and worker bytes against wheel RECORD.
finding_to_source_to_proof.proof: jwm1-9ea7501f-acceptance.log:128 records the exact version, mapped paths, hashes, and RECORD match before either hardware submission.
